big_case.notes: An imminent execution creates exceptional individual stakes and a categorical clemency-policy challenge could reach beyond this applicant. The staged resolution is nevertheless a case-specific stay denial without a stated new rule or demonstrated broader doctrinal effect.

leakage.notes: All 55 calls are outcome_only: execution outcomes were logged but result bodies and dates were not captured. Assessment therefore rests on query subjects and staged prose, not empty dates. Calls seek the October 29 lower-court decision, companion petition metadata and other applications; the prose does not disclose this application's November 5 disposition. Forward retrieval of pre-resolution material is permitted even beyond the frozen baseline.
